title: twenty/v2.46.0
body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- fix(mcp): declare containsAny operator for MULTI_SELECT filter schema (#26744) ([#26748](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26748)) by @PINYOPATTANAWASANPORN
- chore(security): pin adm-zip to 0.6.1 for every consumer ([#27117](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27117)) by @mabdullahabaid
- feat(sharing): reshape record sharing API and share panel ([#27121](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27121)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(usage-limit): replace the limit meter with a usage unit ([#27124](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27124)) by @etiennejouan
- chore(security): upgrade nodemailer to v10 ([#27164](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27164)) by @mabdullahabaid
- chore(security): upgrade @electron/packager to v20 to drop extract-zip ([#27185](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27185)) by @mabdullahabaid
- refactor(ai): drop unused agent history repository registrations and errorDetails field ([#27197](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27197)) by @FelixMalfait
- chore: lift the AI SDK and drop the @ai-sdk/provider resolution ([#27242](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27242)) by @mabdullahabaid
- Remove the install apps onboarding step and rely on pre-installed apps ([#27374](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27374)) by @etiennejouan
- Track application upgrade as a queued job with progress ([#27526](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27526)) by @martmull
- sendInboxMessage takes workspaceMemberIds; one thread key is one conversation ([#27615](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27615)) by @FelixMalfait

## ✨ New features

- feat(enterprise): withhold repeat trials by server id, flag repeat cards for review ([#25620](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25620)) by @ijreilly
- feat: add new mixin guard ([#26663](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26663)) by @BOHEUS
- feat: allow aggregating rating fields ([#26728](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26728)) by @BOHEUS
- feat: admin-issued two-factor authentication recovery codes ([#26933](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26933)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(teams): claim the Microsoft tenant for the workspace on connect ([#27003](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27003)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(ai-chat): A/B test a data-first workspace setup prompt ([#27050](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27050)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(ai-chat): log one structured line per failed turn ([#27102](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27102)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(ai): let runAgent continue a conversation by thread key ([#27135](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27135)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(usage): meter API complexity as the max record fields a query can return ([#27155](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27155)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(mcp): log the JSON-RPC method and tool name and trace tool generation ([#27160](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27160)) by @charlesBochet
- feat(ai): let agents and workflows propose tool calls for approval ([#27169](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27169)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(permissions): add a workspace flag to turn off record share visibility gating ([#27177](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27177)) by @charlesBochet
- feat(workflow): human input instructions for agent steps, routed to the creator's inbox ([#27190](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27190)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(api): select REST fields and cap the default field set ([#27195](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27195)) by @charlesBochet
- feat(ai): ask one question per call and step through every pending request ([#27206](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27206)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(ai): unread badge on the inbox, with inbox state sent as record events ([#27221](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27221)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(ai-chat): # to reference records, @ to bring teammates into a chat ([#27234](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27234)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(workflow): waits as a first-class step outcome, Wait for Event node, agent waits ([#27247](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27247)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(workflow): optional instructions on a form step, with variables ([#27251](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27251)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(ai-chat): one @ menu for teammates and records, grouped by type ([#27258](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27258)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(ai-chat): attach files pasted into the composer ([#27273](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27273)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(workflow): agent steps talk through the inbox like Send to Inbox ([#27287](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27287)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(cli): introduce the Twenty command line ([#27295](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27295)) by @Weiko
- feat(teams): record inbound Teams messages as assistant requests ([#27348](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27348)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(applications): show install and uninstall progress in the action buttons ([#27357](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27357)) by @martmull
- feat(cli): ship a yarn.lock with the app template ([#27523](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27523)) by @Weiko
- feat(slack): restrict the assistant to linked members, drop the default role ([#27533](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27533)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(cli): add explicit object UI creation flags ([#27602](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27602)) by @Weiko
- feat(cli): offer object UI companions interactively ([#27603](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27603)) by @Weiko
- feat(teams): add the Teams assistant agent ([#27654](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27654)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(teams): match a Teams sender to a workspace member by email ([#27659](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27659)) by @abdulrahmancodes

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Forward typed events with React compatibility to front component workers ([#26356](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26356)) by @bosiraphael
- Stamp the requesting application on created call recordings ([#26685](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26685)) by @martmull
- AI: add effort levels to GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol ([#26816](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26816)) by @vladbisceanu
- [1/3] Let apps declare user-scoped application variables ([#26868](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26868)) by @ehconitin
- [2/3] Let each member set their own value of a user application variable ([#26869](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26869)) by @ehconitin
- Speed up CI ~1.8x (front 2.5x, server 1.4x) ([#26876](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26876)) by @neo773
- Add Sync Teams Transcript action that imports a transcript into a Call Recording ([#26914](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26914)) by @ehconitin
- Call recorder: replace the nightly pending-request cron with per-request follow-ups ([#26917](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26917)) by @ehconitin
- [3/3] Cache encrypted user application variable values ([#26941](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26941)) by @ehconitin
- Prevent concurrent workspace cache refreshes from restoring stale data ([#26982](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26982)) by @ehconitin
- Chat inbox: read cursor, unread line, done and snooze per member ([#27046](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27046)) by @FelixMalfait
- Migrate field input pickers and row menus ([#27061](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27061)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate navigation menus and icon pickers ([#27064](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27064)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate address and email autocompletes ([#27065](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27065)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate record and tab dropdown menus ([#27070](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27070)) by @bosiraphael
- Snapshot the AuthPrincipalGuard and application target of every endpoint ([#27082](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27082)) by @prastoin
- Unify resizing with ResizeHandle ([#27083](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27083)) by @bosiraphael
- Bound AI agent steps of application workflow runs by the run roles ([#27115](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27115)) by @thomtrp
- Migrate phone country picker to Twenty UI ([#27125](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27125)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate currency picker to Twenty UI ([#27127](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27127)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate country selection in Twenty UI ([#27128](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27128)) by @bosiraphael
- Keep agent steps in one group and surface reasoning summaries ([#27138](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27138)) by @FelixMalfait
- Add share_record tool to the AI chat ([#27144](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27144)) by @FelixMalfait
- Update snapshot agentThread entity new auth coverage ([#27145](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27145)) by @prastoin
- Take the endpoint permission snapshot from the integration app ([#27147](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27147)) by @prastoin
- Keep the first keystroke typed into a dropdown search ([#27148](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27148)) by @bosiraphael
- Let buttons inside field inputs handle Enter ([#27150](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27150)) by @bosiraphael
- Share record selection state between table and board ([#27166](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27166)) by @FelixMalfait
- Select ranges from an anchor record in table and board ([#27168](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27168)) by @FelixMalfait
- Revert "perf(server): keep workspace cache versions live for 10 minutes before packing" ([#27170](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27170)) by @charlesBochet
- Select several chats in the inbox and act on them at once ([#27171](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27171)) by @FelixMalfait
- Remove AI chat inbox filter dropdown ([#27172](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27172)) by @FelixMalfait
- Select records in list views with cmd+click and shift+click ([#27174](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27174)) by @FelixMalfait
- Drag to select in the inbox ([#27175](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27175)) by @FelixMalfait
- Drag to reorder records in list views ([#27187](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27187)) by @FelixMalfait
- Show the information banner once in the AI chat inbox ([#27188](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27188)) by @FelixMalfait
- Right-click menu on list rows and inbox chats ([#27189](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27189)) by @FelixMalfait
- Clean up record selection, drag and drop, and list code ([#27191](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27191)) by @FelixMalfait
- Show empty list groups again once they have records ([#27198](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27198)) by @FelixMalfait
- Stop fading the board card drag source ([#27203](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27203)) by @FelixMalfait
- Replace hidden chat messages with system messages ([#27207](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27207)) by @FelixMalfait
- Load a member's chat inbox state with its threads ([#27219](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27219)) by @FelixMalfait
- Render chips and markdown in AI reasoning and approval summaries ([#27231](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27231)) by @FelixMalfait
- Serve AI history from workspace storage only and drop the core tables ([#27235](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27235)) by @FelixMalfait
- Show the last message and a Needs input status in the chat inbox ([#27236](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27236)) by @FelixM

## What's Changed
* i18n: Add ja translations for new UI (part 2) by @skkzsh in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4491

title: sdk/v2.44.0
body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Declare application registration variables through the manifest only ([#26856](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26856)) by @prastoin
- Start a record's conversation from the record, and show a conversation's records in its header ([#26873](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26873)) by @FelixMalfait
- Move product URLs out of twenty-ui ([#26908](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26908)) by @bosiraphael

## ✨ New features

- feat(sdk): expose programmatic application client generation ([#26889](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26889)) by @Weiko
- feat(ai): answer every Ask through answerAsk, let agents propose emails and wait on several Asks at once ([#26930](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26930)) by @FelixMalfait

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Support matchMedia in front components ([#24160](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/24160)) by @bosiraphael
- [4/5] Show a record's AI conversations in a Conversations tab behind IS_CONVERSATIONS_TAB_ENABLED ([#26332](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26332)) by @FelixMalfait
- Require the application role to cover every agent role ([#26413](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26413)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Add the schema for campaign click tracking ([#26636](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26636)) by @neo773
